rows: Insert the test socket into its designated place in the relay.
Connect the current injection leads between the injection test set and the test socket as follows: (R-1&N-2).
Connect the voltage injection leads between the injection test set and the test socket as follows: (R-4&N-5).
Connect the timer leads to points (8, 7) on the test socket.
Raise the voltage gradually to the device setting value.
Set the injection current test switch to (5A) and raise the current (preset setting value) gradually until the disc starts to move, and record the pick-up and reset values.

sections_target.text: To calculate the time delay of the device, do the following:

rows: Raise the current to the preset setting value (as per the previous connection).
Raise the voltage to the device setting value.
Set the timer and reset it.
Switch the injection test set 'On'; note the start of the timer.
The injection will switch off automatically when the timer stops.
Record the above results on the test results sheet, sign it and record the date.

Introduction
This document sets out the test steps for the protection device mentioned above. The first draft of this document was prepared by Eng. Gehan Abdel Monsef, and the field test was carried out by Eng. Mokhles Mahmoud Refaei. It was approved by Eng. Mahmoud Saad Balbaa, Sector Head, and reviewed and documented by Eng. Mona El-Sharkawy, Senior Engineering Consultant and Coordinator of the Maintenance Procedures Information System at the West Delta Electricity Production Company.
Safety Precautions
Open a work order.
The circuit breaker of the bay on which the protection device mentioned is installed is open.
Fence off the work area and place warning signs.
Follow the occupational safety and health instructions for the safety of personnel and equipment.
Tools, Instruments and Equipment Used
Secondary injection test set, model a3/TRE-F (ISA)
Measuring instrument, FLUKE 83 I,V
Multi-range ammeters, model VEB, HB
Test leads
Test socket, model TP Form 2, for the protection device mentioned
Secondary injection test set, model a3/TRE-F (ISA)
Measuring instrument, FLUKE 83 I,V
Multi-range ammeters, model VEB, HB
Test leads
Test socket, model TP Form 2, for the protection device mentioned
Procedures to be Carried Out
Insert the test socket into its designated place in the relay. | 1.
Short-circuit points (7-14, 8-12) on the socket. | 2.
Connect the current injection leads between the injection test set and the test socket as follows: (R-1&N-2). | 3.
Connect the voltage injection leads between the injection test set and the test socket as follows: (R-4&N-5). | 4.
Connect the timer leads to points (8, 7) on the test socket. | 5.
Raise the voltage gradually to the device setting value. | 6.
Set the injection current test switch to (5A) and raise the current (preset setting value) gradually until the disc starts to move, and record the pick-up and reset values. | 7.
To calculate the time delay of the device, do the following:
Raise the current to the preset setting value (as per the previous connection). | 1.
Raise the voltage to the device setting value. | 2.
Switch the injection test set 'Off'. | 3.
Set the timer and reset it. | 4.
Switch the injection test set 'On'; note the start of the timer. | 5.
The injection will switch off automatically when the timer stops. | 6.
Record the above results on the test results sheet, sign it and record the date. | 7.
